changes.text: Everyone starts again on an even footing: stocks, Cash, cards, cosmetics, prizes, predictions, achievements and notifications from the playtest were reset, and chat and comments were cleared. You get the same starting Cash and credit as a brand-new account.
Your account, username, profile, oshi and friends are just as they were.
Stock prices were rebuilt from each talent's YouTube history, without the playtest's trades. The upcoming IPO is still on.

Sign-up, About and How to play now say what you start with: $10,000 cash for stocks and $100,000 Credit for games, predictions and fees. Your profile measures your all-time change, and draws its start line, from that $110,000.
